verdicts.reason: A is fragmented. The logo sits alone at the far left, off the headline's axis. The tiny 'How It Works' pill is jammed against the end of the headline, so the CTA reads as a badge and not an action. The legal text runs as a microscopic full-width strip, and the suitcase is crammed against the top and bottom edges. B reads better from logo to headline to subhead, with the headline clearly dominant. But its CTA is undersized and pushed to the bottom-left, off the centred text axis, the legal copy is squeezed beside it at an illegible size, and the suitcase and its circle are cropped tight at the canvas edges.
